message: My card machine won't connect to the internet, what should I do?
answer:
The issue with your card machine not connecting to the internet is related to the 4G chip registration. To resolve the issue, follow these steps: 
• With the machine turned off, open the rear cover and insert the chip into the designated slot, with the metallic side facing downwards [1].
• Close the cover, turn on the machine, and wait for the network connection to establish [1].
• Once connected, perform a communication test by pressing the function button, # or the machine's button, then 60, and select option 2 (maintenance) and then option 1 (communication test) [1].
If the issue persists, check the 4G chip registration and ensure it is properly configured, as the problem may be related to the chip registration [3].

message: Como funciona a antecipação de recebíveis na Getnet?
answer:
The Antecipação of Sales feature allows merchants to receive payments for their sales in advance, up to 2 days after the sale date. This feature is available for merchants who have a Getnet account and have opted for the "Receba Conforme suas Vendas" payment plan. [1]

To be eligible for Antecipação of Sales, merchants must meet certain conditions, including having a minimum of 2 days' worth of sales in their account. [2] The feature is not available for all merchants, and the Getnet team reserves the right to evaluate each contract individually to determine eligibility. [2]

When a merchant opts for Antecipação of Sales, they will receive an email with the details of their contract, which will outline the terms and conditions of the feature. [4] The merchant must also meet certain requirements, such as maintaining a minimum faturamento and being adimplent, to receive the discount associated with the Antecipação of Sales feature. [4]

It's worth noting that the Antecipação of Sales feature is only available for sales made through the Getnet payment system, and not for sales made through other payment channels. [1]

message: What is the Getnet crediário?
answer:
The Getnet crediário is a type of in-store installment credit offered by Getnet to merchants. It is part of the merchant's contract with Getnet and can be managed through the Getnet Portal and/or the Getnet Brasil App [1]. 

The crediário allows merchants to offer their customers installment payment options, with each card issuer setting its own limits on the number of installments [2]. The interest rates for the customer are displayed through a simulation on the card machine, allowing the merchant to inform the customer about the terms of the payment [2]. 

To enable the crediário, merchants must contact Getnet's Central de Atendimento and request its activation [1]. The crediário can be disabled by contacting the same support team [3].
